english.title: Obstruct a person acting in the execution of the Highways Act 1980 / byelaw or order made under it
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) wilfully obstructed **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person acting in the execution of

(A)_[the]_
(B)_[a byelaw or order, namely **(..SPECIFY BYELAW OR ORDER..), made under the]_

Highways Act 1980
english.legislation: Contrary to section 303 of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
wilfully obstruct a person
acting in the execution of
the Act / byelaw / order made under it

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings for this offence shall not without the written consent of the Attorney General, be taken by any person other than the person aggrieved, or a highway authority or council having an interest in the enforcement of the provision or byelaws in question - section 312 Highways Act 1980.
(ii) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980
(iii) This wording should only be used if there is no other provision in the Act for such an obstruction.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant wilfully obstructed **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person acting in the execution of

(A)_[the]_
(B)_[a byelaw or order, namely **(..SPECIFY BYELAW OR ORDER..), made under the]_

Highways Act 1980.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level one on the standard scale and if the offence is continued after conviction he is guilty of a further offence and to a further fine of £5 for each day on which the offence continues.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
